headline: Sensex and Nifty recover as IT stocks lead gains; new fuel-efficiency norms notified for passenger vehicles

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: IT stocks like TCS and Wipro rebounded up to 6% after an eight-day losing streak
Moderating oil prices helped the market recover from recent slides
Positive brokerage calls and new order wins boosted specific mid-cap stocks
Global cues and moderating oil prices supported a recovery in Sensex and Nifty
whatHappening: The Indian government notified tighter CAFE-3 fuel-efficiency norms for passenger vehicles
Sensex and Nifty are on track for their worst nine-month performance in 15 years
A large block deal worth Rs 883 crore led to a sharp drop in Avalon Tech shares
Healthcare and pharmaceutical stocks are underperforming the broader market today
summary: Indian markets recovered on Wednesday as IT stocks snapped a losing streak, with the Sensex gaining over 100 points. The government introduced stricter fuel-efficiency norms for vehicles, while specific stocks like STL Networks and KSB rallied on new contract wins. Despite the daily gain, indices are heading toward their worst nine-month performance in over a decade.
